context: Sentences from Wikipedia about the domain "Music Ontology". Use only these relations, written exactly as given: composer (musical work -> human); part of (musical work -> album); lyrics by (musical work -> human); publication date (musical work -> value); language of work or name (musical work -> language); voice type (human -> voice); instrumentation (musical work -> value); tracklist (album -> musical work); genre (musical work -> music genre); performer (musical work -> value); producer (album -> value); nominated for (album -> award ); record label (album -> value).
